limitations.note: The rewrite fixed counting through input stalls but also made `ready_a` high during reset and allowed acceptance on the first edge after reset release, whereas the reference retains registered readiness.

Placing this assignment inside the `valid_a` branch changed `valid_b` from a registered `cnt == 5` indication to a pulse only when the sixth bit is accepted, suppressing the reference output during a stall at count five.
The test exercised reset and stalls at count five but expected the rewrite’s always-high readiness and sixth-acceptance pulse, so it passed without detecting the changes from the reference behavior.
